card.name: Punctuation and linkers before a coming list item
card.fires_on: Small linking tokens such as a colon, comma, 'and', 'must', 'to' or 'which' in running prose, where a new item or clause is about to start. It is strongest on the colon and commas inside a list of place names.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: Colon, comma or 'and' inside a list of named places.
modes.example: is being piloted in four Free Library neighborhood branches<<:>> Cobbs Creek, West Oak Lane,

modes.label: Verbs and linkers before 'conform'
modes.description: Words like 'must', 'to' or 'not' just before a verb such as conform or fit.
modes.example: there are some rules to which all tragic heroes<< must>> conform.

card.plain: It fires on small joining words and punctuation, mostly in lists, just before the next item appears.
